sources.inspection_note: 親讀 abstract與§1–2 pp.1–2：perfect calibration Eq.1 P(prediction correct | reported confidence=p)=p；finite-sample bin acc/conf定義。支持信心必另對真值檢查，而非高softmax保證正確；只談分類confidence，本節未宣稱整段回答可信度等於某token機率。a_calibration/a_calibration_text。
